name: LabInfo
note: A space-owner MOD for the atlas space (copy to spaces/atlas/modos/mods/labinfo.json, which is not tracked). It extends the foundational WorldInfo: the same answer about the place, plus the lab's prefabricated dioramas on the lab table.
description: What this lab (the Programmable Reality Lab, PRL) is: what it researches, who is in it, and what lab life and its way of doing research are like.
examples: What is lab life like here?
Can you tell me more about what they're working on?

allowed.description: Lab work and research content: research topics and vision (programmable reality), AR/VR, robotics, shape-changing interfaces.
Lab requirements, lab life and how the lab does research: principles, culture, writing first, papers and internships.
No animation: plain facts (who leads the lab, who its students are, its name) or not about the lab.

diorama.label: Diorama and text
diorama.description: A prefabricated animation on the lab table when it fits the question, with text beside it.
